schema.title: Minecraft Resource Pack Lang

description:
Dear Team,

I’ve compiled the latest language entries for our Minecraft resource pack so you can see exactly how each element will appear in‑game. The main menu now offers the options “Singleplayer” and “Multiplayer”, while the interface buttons read “Done” and “Cancel”. Settings are labeled “Graphics” and “Sound”, and the player’s inventory is simply titled “Inventory”. When a player opens their collection, they’ll see the “Tools” item group, and any enchanted gear will display the effect name “Glowing”.  

For the in‑world objects, the translations are straightforward: diamonds are called “Diamond”, iron ingots appear as “Iron Ingot”, stone blocks show up as “Stone”, and oak planks are labeled “Oak Planks”. The hostile creature known as a “Creeper” retains its name, and the achievement for finding diamonds reads “Diamonds!”. Advancements follow the theme of the early game; the “Stone Age” advancement carries the title “Stone Age” with the description “Mine stone with your new pickaxe”. Chat announcements use the format “[​%s​] %s”, and the generic death message displays as “%1$s died”. All of these entries are ready for inclusion in the language file.
